units.source_text: “迩来但望日月推迁，悲伤渐减，岂知历时越久，悲伤越增。

en.t: Lately I had only hoped that as the days and months passed, my grief would gradually lessen; who could have known that the more time went by, the more my sorrow would grow?
This is truly something for which there is no help!
How has the young child been lately?
The child is always in my thoughts.

units.source_text: 不得与太君共同抚养，实为憾事。

en.t: It is truly a matter of regret that I cannot raise the child together with Your Ladyship.

units.source_text: 今请视此子为亡人之遗念，偕同入宫。”

en.t: Now I ask you to regard this child as a keepsake of the departed one and bring the child with you into the palace.
